profile.headline: Software Engineer II | AI Tooling & Ad Tech | Next.js · AWS · Snowflake · LLM Evaluation
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 17+ years building scalable fullstack systems across ad tech, streaming, ecommerce, and enterprise SaaS.

Currently at DIRECTV Ads leading AI tooling strategy — building LLM evaluation platforms and internal developer tools, including reducing a critical business process from 7.5 hours to under 30 minutes through AI-assisted optimization.

I bring full stack depth across Next.js, Python, AWS, Snowflake, and Kubernetes, combined with a rare background spanning data engineering, payment systems, ecommerce platforms, and technical mentorship.

MS Software Engineering, 3.93 GPA, Distinguished Graduate · BS Mathematics (Minors: Computer Science, Engineering) · SMU Full Stack Certificate

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Led AI tooling strategy across the Ads engineering organization — evaluating AI assistants, code models, vendors, agents, and platforms to guide adoption decisions.

• Reduced a critical ad order processing pipeline from 7.5 hours to under 30 minutes using AI-assisted code analysis and optimization — a 93% improvement on a revenue-critical workflow
• Built an LLM evaluation platform to benchmark multiple AI models for video and audio analysis, identifying a low-cost solution for AI-based content moderation
• Built internal video authoring tool prototype replacing a legacy toolset, receiving strong early user adoption and shaping the product roadmap
• Developed Content Moderation UI enabling the compliance team to automatically review ads at scale with aggregate and detailed reporting
• Designed and implemented an AI development workflow with automated webhooks covering static analysis, unit, integration, security, accessibility, and regression testing — patterns shared and adopted across the team
• Built and maintained fullstack web (Next.js) for internal ad operations tooling
• Engineered data pipelines for ad targeting platform using Python, Java, Snowflake, and AWS
• Led migration of Xandr (AT&T) ad data services to DIRECTV, modernizing a critical ad revenue platform across Node.js, React, Snowflake, Kubernetes, AWS, Jenkins, and WSO2
• Participated in architecture and technical decisions for backend APIs and frontend UI across multiple product teams
• Mentored and guided software engineers across the organization

positions.title: Software Engineer II/Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and extended Xandr's enterprise ad platform built with React, Redux, Node.js, MaterialUI, and D3.js (Victory) with connections to Looker and Snowflake
• Participated in architecture discussions and technical decisions for backend (API) and frontend (UI) development
• Built AWS infrastructure using S3, DynamoDB, Parameter Store, and Lambda functions
• Managed CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins and troubleshot Kubernetes pod deployments in production
• Provided mentorship and guidance to engineers across the UI team
• Collaborated with multiple teams and product owners across the organization

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained React/Redux/Node.js application with D3.js visualizations and AWS integrations (S3, Workspaces, DynamoDB, Lambda, AWS CLI)
• Participated in architecture discussions for backend API and frontend UI development
• Provided mentorship and guidance to the UI team
• Collaborated with multiple teams and product owners

positions.title: Full Stack Development Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for SMU's intensive Full Stack Web Development Bootcamp — mentoring career-changers learning to code from scratch.

• Mentored students learning fullstack web development including HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB, and MySQL
• Supported instructors in delivering curriculum, debugging student code, and reinforcing technical concepts in real time
• Developed the ability to communicate complex engineering concepts clearly to non-technical audiences — a skill applied daily in cross-functional work and technical mentorship

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and supported application solutions across ecommerce, payments, reporting, and cloud infrastructure. Gathered business and technical requirements. Led offshore teams when necessary.

• Owned end-to-end development of Oracle Commerce Cloud (OCC) ecommerce platform including frontend (HTML/CSS/JS/Knockout.js), backend Node.js custom order processing layer, and Oracle EBS integration
• Sole owner of payment infrastructure including Braintree, PayPal, and fraud prevention via Kount — including rules configuration, authorization troubleshooting, and settlement support
• Built and launched Petmate CFO Contest web application using Google Firebase Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, React, and Bootstrap
• Designed and built store locator API with Google Maps GeoCode integration; later modernized from PHP/WordPress to Firebase Cloud Functions and React
• Built POS database and reporting solution on Azure SQL Server 2014
• Maintained reporting suite across Microsoft Power BI, Crystal Reports, and custom VBA Excel solutions
• Led offshore contractor team on Oracle EBS integration projects
• Managed third-party data feed integrations including Bazaar Voice and Vertex tax solution

positions.title: BI Developer, SQL Database Developer, Cognos Data Modeler, Cognos Administrator, DBA
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained BI reporting infrastructure using Cognos including data modeling, report building, and platform administration
• Developed and optimized stored procedures for dashboard applications and BI reports with a focus on database performance tuning
• Managed database administration and SQL development across enterprise reporting systems

positions.title: QA and Development
positions.description:
• SQL programming and database development
• .NET and Flex application testing
• BIRT report development and maintenance
• Release management across the engineering organization

positions.title: Loyalty Software Services Technician
positions.description:
• Built and maintained online and paper survey systems using SQL, HTML, CSS, and C++
• Programmed and troubleshot survey workflows and reporting pipelines
• Supported release processes across the engineering team

projects.title: IoT Waste Sensor & Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
IoT Waste Sensor & Analytics Dashboard

End-to-end IoT system built as graduate capstone project. Designed and 
implemented a full data pipeline from physical sensor to cloud to dashboard:

• Programmed microcontroller sensor to detect and transmit fill-level data 
  via MQTT protocol
• Ingested and stored real-time sensor data in Google Firebase
• Built React/JAMstack dashboard to visualize live and historical sensor data
• Designed complete system architecture independently from hardware to UI

Stack: Microcontroller · MQTT · Google Firebase · React · JAMstack
